scope: Proposition 12.7 (Local endpoint joining) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 161. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Proposition 12.6, Lemma 6.1, and the compact sewing interface (T1)–(T3) of Section 6, with vanishing projected edge diameters. In a joint extraction on such a chart, arbitrary primal-vertex endpoints whose continuum locations approach the same point can be joined at cost o(B(n)), with the path confined to any prescribed open neighborhood of that point. The conclusion is uniform over endpoints in a fixed compact chart, in the usual sequential sense. The same conclusion applies in a bilateral exhaustion whenever the tested vertices have tight chronological representatives in its compact sewings.
